name: Entity Count
description: Builds an admin report listing the number of stored entities per entity type, with an optional per-bundle breakdown, under Administration > Reports.
project_description: Simple module that reports the count for each entity type, and the count per bundle when a type has more than one bundle. Useful for keeping track of how many entities are currently stored in the database and for performance planning. Under Administration > Reports you will find the "Entity count" link; clicking it lists entity types with their counts, and — for types with multiple bundles — a per-bundle report.
